source_full: So the guards left him alone and he stuck up his long stick near the well, Hung his cloak round the stick and put his hat on the top. He also hung his knapsack up inside the cloak so that it might seem to have some body within it.
target_full: 于是守卫们便让他独自留下，他把长棍子插在井边，把斗篷挂在棍子上，帽子放在棍子顶端。他还把背包挂在斗篷里面，这样看起来好像里面真的有个人似的。
